name: Beit
description: Beit is a quantum computing software R&D company developing novel quantum algorithms for molecular modelling and computational chemistry. Founded in Krakow, the company focuses on solving NP-complete problems and has organized the Originating Quantum Advantage in Poland workshop, the largest gathering of quantum computing experts in Central and Eastern Europe.

products.name: Quantum Algorithm R&D Platform
products.description: Novel quantum algorithms for molecular modelling, computational chemistry, and NP-complete optimization problems

highlights: One of the earliest quantum computing companies in Central and Eastern Europe, founded 2016
Organizes the Originating Quantum Advantage workshop, the largest quantum gathering in CEE
Specializes in solving NP-complete problems with quantum algorithmic approaches

news.title: Poland's Vibrant QC Representative
news.excerpt: Poland has recently joined the quantum computing party with the Krakow-based startup, Beit.Tech, founded in 2016 by CEO Paulina Mazurek, Chief Physics Officer Wojciech Burkot and Chief Mathematics Officer Witold Jarnicki to design algorithms for NP-complete problems.

news.title: Ex-Google founders bet quantum-compressed chemistry can crack covalent drug design
news.excerpt: BEIT Inc., a quantum computing startup founded by ex-Googlers in Kraków, has launched CovAngelo, a hybrid quantum-classical platform designed to accurately model chemical reactions in complex molecular environments.
